pages.name: Parham Attack/Scholar's Mate
pages.notes: The page is the final position of the Scholar's Mate (4.Qxf7 is checkmate), but the overview and plans advised Black to defend f7 with ...g6. Rewrote overview and both plans.

pages.name: King's Pawn Opening: Van Hooydoon Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 4 castled with the f1-bishop at home. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling in plan 2. Overview not settled: it says Black sacrifices a knight, but 6...Nxd4 attacks the e2-queen and after 7.Nxd4 Bxd4 Black is a pawn up; plan 1's 'bishop on d4' also assumes that line. No source found to settle the gambit's real line.
